operate-sections.noRuns: No runs yet. Trigger a run from the header or wait for the schedule.

editable-sections.concurrencyCoalesceDesc: Keep one follow-up run queued while an active run is still working.
editable-sections.concurrencyAlwaysDesc: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if several runs stack up.
editable-sections.concurrencySkipDesc: Drop overlapping trigger occurrences while the routine is already active.
editable-sections.catchUpSkipDesc: Ignore schedule windows that were missed while paused.
editable-sections.catchUpEnqueueDesc: Catch up missed schedule windows after recovery; sub-hourly schedules are combined into one catch-up run, slower schedules replay each missed window up to a cap.
editable-sections.gateAlwaysDesc: Fire on the schedule no matter what — the default behavior.
editable-sections.gateRequireTitle: Skip when there's been no activity since the last run
editable-sections.gateRequireDesc: On a scheduled tick, only run if something happened since the last run that finished. Lets a watcher-style routine stay asleep while the system is settled instead of burning tokens.
editable-sections.signingBearer: Expect a shared bearer token in the Authorization header.
editable-sections.signingHmac: Expect an HMAC SHA-256 signature over the request using the shared secret.
editable-sections.signingGithub: Accept GitHub-style X-Hub-Signature-256 header (HMAC over raw body, no timestamp).
editable-sections.signingNone: No authentication — the webhook URL itself acts as a shared secret.
editable-sections.scopeOrgDesc: Any activity across the organization counts as a reason to run.
editable-sections.scopeProjectDesc: Only activity in the routine's project counts as a reason to run.
editable-sections.scopeCompanyDesc: Any activity across the company counts as a reason to run.
editable-sections.agentRequired: Default agent required. This routine can stay as a draft and still run manually, but automation stays paused until you assign a default agent.
editable-sections.variablesHint: Variables are auto-detected from {{token}} in the title and instructions. The variable name is read-only — rename by editing the placeholder.
editable-sections.noVariables: No variables yet. Add a {{placeholder}} in the title or instructions to create one.
editable-sections.secretsHint: Routine secrets apply to every task this routine creates. They override matching keys in project and agent env. <mono>{{prefix}}</mono> names are reserved.
editable-sections.saveNow: Save this now. Myrmidon will not show the secret value again.
editable-sections.gateNeedsSchedule: Add a schedule trigger to gate runs on activity. Webhook, manual, and API fires always run.
editable-sections.previewNote: Preview assumes the previous run is still in flight when the next fires. Times shown in {{timeZone}}.
editable-sections.previewEmpty: No enabled schedule trigger to preview. Add a schedule in Triggers to see how this policy treats upcoming fires.
